adopt.description: Moves this instance's existing '{target}' into the shared store and links it. The instance must be stopped.

sync.description: Worlds, mod config and keybinds are shared with your other instances.
sync.join_description: The shared copies replace anything of this instance's they clash with — its own copies of those worlds and settings are deleted. Everything else it has joins the store.
sync.leave_description: Every folder it shares is copied out of the store, so that data will exist twice and the two copies drift apart from here. Nothing is deleted.
sync.no_targets: No folders are shared — add some under Settings › Instances.
sync.now_alone: This instance keeps its settings to itself
sync.now_sharing: This instance shares its settings again
sync.off_launcher_wide: Sharing is off for every instance — turn it on under Settings › Instances.
sync.opted_out: This instance keeps its own settings, configs and worlds.
sync.title: Shared settings
